analysis.no_pooling: donors and ordered directions are averaged within state
analysis.permutation: exact source-label permutation among all four sources within recipient (chance 0.25); frozen cyclic derangement and random exact within-state permutations seeded 20260903
analysis.within_state_measurements: four branches, 12 ordered directions, repeats, and controls

controls.coordinates: zero direct writes to action input and output coordinates
controls.donor_replay: every one of 12 donor clamps repeated exactly
controls.gaussian: one geometry-matched Gaussian future per ordered pair; norm and distance relative errors <= 1e-5
controls.native_future_distinctness: report whether all four native future hashes are distinct; do not exclude or adapt a state when they are not
controls.native_repeat: exact action, future, and x0 replay for all four seeds
controls.self: clean self-future clamp repeated exactly for all four recipients
controls.shuffle: balanced cyclic derangement across all four future-source labels; source-label permutation includes self
controls.state_hash: exactly one model-state fingerprint within each unit
controls.target_future: report every full-clamp target error and require <= 0.03; threshold frozen from the pre-existing 22-state cohort (366 arms, observed max 0.028531551361083984) and excluded development audit before this manifest
controls.wrong_donor: deterministic nonrecipient/nondonor label from frozen branch-seed order

design.branchpoint_mapping: nearest valid timestep congruent to 16 mod 32 in [1,length-1]; ties choose lower; assert exactly three distinct steps or stop
design.nonoverlap: new steps are 16 mod 32; existing cohort steps are 0 mod 32
design.recipient_action_noise: fixed to each ordered pair's recipient branch seed
